note: The HIFI YouTube channel plan. tools/build.mjs reads this with stations.json and, for streams with a catalog, live/music/catalog.json; tools/art.mjs renders the images named here; publish/<id>.txt are the texts to paste into YouTube Studio. Nothing here publishes anything.

channel.name: HIFI
channel.handleNote: Check availability when the channel is created; take the first that is free.
channel.description:
HIFI is radio on a tape that never ends: a mid-90s den shot on a camcorder, a record turning on the deck and the station's own clips on the TV. Six stations stream around the clock: four synth stations, Lo-Fi Beats to Work To and, in December, Fireside Christmas.

Every note is our own. The synth stations and the lo-fi beats are composed in the HIFI studio; the Christmas carols are public-domain melodies in our own acoustic arrangements. No samples, no licensed music.

Listen in the HIFI app, a click-wheel iPod radio for iPhone, Mac and the web: https://hifi.nates-software.com/
channel.syntheticContent: Disclose: yes. The rooms are AI-generated photographs and the TV clips are AI-generated video, realistic enough that YouTube's altered or synthetic content label applies.

encoding.note: YouTube Live ingest for 1080p30: H.264 high profile, 2 s keyframes, CBR-like rate, AAC 48 kHz stereo. Six streams at once need about 6 x 6.5 = 39 Mbps of steady upload; drop videoBitrate to 4500k or run fewer streams if the line can't hold it.

streams.title: Night Build · dark ambient for after-hours coding · HIFI 24/7
streams.about: Dark ambient for the hours after everyone logs off. The den at 11:38 PM, the city out the window, a blue lava lamp and Night Build on the deck.

streams.title: Dial-Up · lo-fi soft breaks for rainy afternoons · HIFI 24/7
streams.about: Soft breaks and rain on the window, the way the internet sounded when it took a while. A grey afternoon in April 1997.

streams.title: Shareware Summer · sunny synth funk for long afternoons · HIFI 24/7
streams.about: Synth funk for a long afternoon with nothing due. Sun through the blinds, the trial never expires.

streams.title: Pixel Drift · chiptune to focus to · HIFI 24/7
streams.about: Chiptune at dusk: save points, friendly bosses, no quarters needed.

streams.title: Lo-Fi Beats to Work To · instrumental hip-hop, rain on the glass · HIFI 24/7
streams.about: Instrumental hip-hop for heads-down work: dusty drums, warm keys, rain on the glass. Composed in the HIFI studio. (In the HIFI app this station relays SomaFM; this stream plays our own catalog instead.)

streams.title: Fireside Christmas · acoustic carols by the fire · HIFI 24/7
streams.about: Our own acoustic takes on the old carols, by the fire on TV, with snow on the sill. Christmas Eve, 1996.
streams.tagline: Our own acoustic takes on the old carols.

season.note: Live from December 1 to January 6; off the rest of the year.

streams.rights: Public-domain compositions only, in HIFI Studio arrangements. Modern songs (White Christmas, Last Christmas, All I Want for Christmas Is You and the like) need licensing even as covers, so they are not on this stream.
